english.title: Fail without reasonable excuse to do something required by a section 21 notice
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been required by the chairman of the **(..SPECIFY INQUIRY..) by a notice under section 21 of the Inquiries Act 2005

(A)_[to attend **(..SPECIFY PLACE..) at **(..SPECIFY TIME AND DATE..) to give evidence,]_
(B)_[to attend **(..SPECIFY PLACE..) at **(..SPECIFY TIME AND DATE..) to produce a document under your custody or control, namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENT..), that related to a matter in question at that inquiry,]_
(C)_[to attend **(..SPECIFY PLACE..) at **(..SPECIFY TIME AND DATE..) to produce documents under your custody or control, namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENTS..), that related to a matter in question at that inquiry,]_
(D)_[to attend **(..SPECIFY PLACE..) at **(..SPECIFY TIME AND DATE..) to produce something in your custody or control, namely **(..SPECIFY ITEM..), for inspection, examination or testing by or on behalf of the inquiry panel,]_
(E)_[provide evidence to the inquiry panel, in the form of a written statement,]_
(F)_[to produce a document under your custody or control, namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENT..), that related to a matter in question at that inquiry,]_
(G)_[to produce documents under your custody or control, namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENTS..), that related to a matter in question at that inquiry,]_
(H)_[to produce something in your custody or control, namely **(..SPECIFY ITEM..), for inspection, examination or testing by or on behalf of the inquiry panel,]_

failed without reasonable excuse to do so
english.legislation: Contrary to section 35(1) and (7) of the Inquiries Act 2005.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Section 35(5) of the Inquiries Act 2005 provides that "Proceedings in England and Wales or in Northern Ireland for an offence under section 35(1) may be instituted only by the chairman" of the inquiry.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 51 weeks imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Note: In relation to an offence committed before the commencement of section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003, the reference to 51 weeks is to be read as a reference to six months.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
